svg.title: Distributed Cache · financial quorum path
svg.desc: A 500k-user distributed cache for balanced financial reads and writes, with explicit request routing, virtual-node placement, physical cache-server replicas, read/write quorums, HIT/MISS paths, write-through, Cassandra consistency, eviction, and monitoring.

text.tspan: REQUEST ROUTING · LOAD BALANCER SPREADS TRAFFIC · CACHE CLIENT COORDINATES REPLICAS
KEY PLACEMENT · HASH THE KEY · SELECT THE NEXT VIRTUAL NODE CLOCKWISE · FIND ITS SHARD
CACHE SERVERS · ONE SHARD HAS THREE PHYSICAL SERVERS · READ AND WRITE QUORUMS OVERLAP
OBSERVABILITY · PROVE CACHE SPEED AND CONSISTENCY
Hashes each key, selects replicas, and
waits for the required cache and
1. hash(key) produces one position on the ring.
2. Starting at that position, move clockwise.
3. Stop at the first virtual-node token encountered.
4. In this example, that token is vB2.
5. The key range ending at vB2 maps to logical Cache Shard B.
6. Shard B’s replica-selection rule then chooses physical server B1, B2, or
vB2 owns the ring interval after its predecessor and up to vB2.
vB2 maps its owned key range to
N=3: three physical servers per shard.
R=2: read two versioned values; return the newest.
W=2: require two cache write acknowledgements.
R+W>N: the read and write quorums intersect.
ONE SERVER DOWN: two healthy replicas still form a quorum.
FEWER THAN TWO: do not serve a single potentially stale copy.
A financial write is acknowledged only after both required
quorums succeed for the same version. If either side fails,
do not acknowledge; invalidate or bypass the cache until
Evicted or expired keys follow the MISS path to
Cassandra and then refill the cache.
RF=3: Cassandra stores 3 durable copies of each row.
CL=QUORUM: 2 of 3 database replicas must respond to the read or write.
PARTITION KEY: user_id chooses the database partition.
GOAL · 500K USERS · BALANCED R/W · FINANCIAL KEYS REQUIRE STRONG CONSISTENCY
INVARIANT · NO CLIENT OBSERVES A VALUE OLDER THAN THE LAST ACKNOWLEDGED WRITE
THREE PHYSICAL SERVERS HOLD THIS SHARD
